caption: Preview six source Rems and three warnings before import.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['remnote-json-import']; for (const m of [...p.modals]) m.close(); const source = await app.vault.read(app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath('RemNote JSON Import/rem.json')); p.pro.signOut(); p.settings.presets = []; window.__rniSource = source; window.__rniFolder = 'Biology import '+Date.now(); p.openImport(); const m = [...p.modals].pop(); m.text = source; m.contentEl.querySelector('textarea').value = source; m.contentEl.querySelector('textarea').rows = 2; m.setLayout({folder:window.__rniFolder,prefix:'',groupRoots:[]}); m.showPreview(); return 'ok'; })()

caption: The imported Cells note has a parent link, a DNA reference and a child link.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['remnote-json-import']; for (const m of [...p.modals]) m.close(); const source = await app.vault.read(app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath('RemNote JSON Import/rem.json')); p.pro.signOut(); await p.importText(source,{folder:window.__rniFolder,prefix:'',groupRoots:[]}); const root = app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(window.__rniFolder); const file = root.children.find(f => f.name.startsWith('Cells--')); await app.workspace.getLeaf(false).openFile(file,{state:{mode:'preview'}}); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Save a layout preset with a filename prefix and subtree root.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['remnote-json-import']; for (const m of [...p.modals]) m.close(); const source = await app.vault.read(app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath('RemNote JSON Import/rem.json')); p.pro.opts.http = async () => ({status:200,json:{data:{viewer:{login:'demo-reader'},user:{sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor:{isActive:true,isOneTimePayment:false,tier:{name:'$5 a month',monthlyPriceInCents:500}}}}}}); app.secretStorage.setSecret('remnote-json-import-github-token','gho_'+'0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow(); await p.savePreset('Biology document',{folder:'Biology documents',prefix:'Study ',groupRoots:['biology']}); p.openImport(); const m = [...p.modals].pop(); m.text = source; m.contentEl.querySelector('textarea').value = source; m.contentEl.querySelector('textarea').rows = 2; m.setLayout(p.applyPreset('Biology document')); m.showPreview(); return 'ok'; })()
